identity.name: ResumeGenie AI
identity.headline: The world's most advanced AI resume optimizer

metrics.text: raised $2 million in a pre-seed round

tech_claims.text: ResumeGenie is powered by advanced proprietary AI that rewrites your resume line by line.

_expected.note: Human grading block only. Not read by the pipeline (extra top-level keys are ignored by pipeline.run).
_expected.ground_truth_note: Invented fake product for the vibecode teardown demo: a $49/mo resume rewriter is, on its face, a thin wrapper around an LLM API call plus formatting, not a moat.

teardown_hint.why: Core value prop is an LLM prompt (rewrite resume text against a job description) plus a Stripe paywall and a landing page. No proprietary model, no hard infra, no unique distribution evidenced by the claims.
